cases.description: An OpenAI SDK app with a comment linking a huggingface.co model card: provider.openai is expected, provider.huggingface is not

files.src/app.py:
import os

from openai import OpenAI

# Prompt wording adapted from the model card at
# https://huggingface.co/meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (system prompt section).
SYSTEM = "You are a terse assistant for the shipping desk."

client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ["OPENAI_API_KEY"])


def answer(question: str) -> str:
    response = client.chat.completions.create(
        model="gpt-4o-mini",
        messages=[{"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM}, {"role": "user", "content": question}],
    )
    return response.choices[0].message.content or ""

cases.description: huggingface_hub InferenceClient using the OpenAI-compatible chat.completions.create call shape: provider.huggingface, never provider.openai

files.scripts/translate.py:
import os
import sys

from huggingface_hub import InferenceClient

client = InferenceClient(model="Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-en-de", token=os.environ.get("HF_TOKEN"))


def translate(text: str) -> str:
    completion = client.chat.completions.create(
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": f"Translate to German: {text}"}],
        max_tokens=256,
    )
    return completion.choices[0].message.content


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(translate(" ".join(sys.argv[1:])))

files.triage/agent.py:
from pydantic_ai import Agent

triage = Agent("openai:gpt-4o-mini", system_prompt="Classify support tickets by urgency.")


async def classify(text: str) -> str:
    result = await triage.run(text)
    return result.output
files.tests/test_agent.py:
import pytest

from triage.agent import classify


async def handoff(ticket: dict) -> dict:
    """Simulate passing a classified ticket to the on-call queue."""
    ticket["queue"] = "on-call" if ticket["urgency"] == "high" else "backlog"
    return ticket


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_handoff_routes_high_urgency():
    ticket = await handoff({"urgency": "high"})
    assert ticket["queue"] == "on-call"


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_classify_returns_text(monkeypatch):
    assert callable(classify)

files.router.py:
import litellm
import yaml

with open("config/models.yaml") as fh:
    MODELS = yaml.safe_load(fh)["model_list"]


def complete(prompt: str) -> str:
    entry = MODELS[0]["litellm_params"]
    response = litellm.completion(model=entry["model"], messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}])
    return response.choices[0].message.content
